Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can.In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 card with [Garurumon]/[X Antibody] in its name is among the 4 revealed cards?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the 4 cards revealed for this card's effect include 1 each of a card with [Garurumon]/[X Antibody] in their names, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
Can I use this card's effect to add 2 cards with [Garurumon] in their names to my hand when 2 cards with [Garurumon] in their names and 1 card with [X Antibody] are among the 4 revealed cards?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 2 cards with [Garurumon] or [X Antibody] in their names among them to the hand. Place the rest at the bottom of the deck. If you added cards, trash 1 card in your hand.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name would be deleted in battle, by returning 2 non-Digi-Egg cards from your trash to the bottom of the deck, prevent that deletion.
